experiment: Full isolated UX replay, native configuration, inline then file-backed repair
scope: Complete UX authoring, validation, persistence, independent review and repair; no UI or live promotion

nonoverlappingTimeline.phase: Initial generation, further reads and self-correction
Structural repairs, persistence and review preparation
First review including preparation, collection and delivery
Review inspection and initial repair dispatch before interruption
Resume coordination and original author recovery
Linkage correction, validation, persistence and review preparation
Second review including preparation, collection and delivery
Final receipt validation, preservation checks and reporting

limits: Initial 19 author reads were serial despite parallel_tool_calls=true; later author reads batched up to five.
File-backed repair changed the experiment protocol after the first review; this is not a paired transport-speed comparison.
Actor windows overlap. Idle specialists can have large window gaps; active-turn fields separate recorded activity.
Output-item intervals measure command streams, not pure computation or network transfer.
The early decisions-ready marker does not mean all useful design reasoning ended there.
Token counts are repeated context accounting, include cached input, and are not dollar charges.
Metrics stop at isolated client completion; supervisor analysis, reporting and checkpoint time are excluded.

control.interruptionReason: Supervisor stopped the verified isolated client after the saved revise receipt to permit deterministic temporary-file repair and MCP file import, avoiding whole-unit JSON regeneration.

serviceFailures.error: UX review receipt verdict must be pass before UI persistence
